notes:
## Changes

- Accelerate both passes of six-tap cubic downsampling in Super with ARM64 NEON. The integer weights, rounding, and edge handling are preserved.
- Precompute and reuse cubic motion-field sampling weights for supported 8-bit OpenCL shader 23 frames with a 16-pixel grid on Apple Silicon.
- Add regression tests for SIMD pixel parity, shader selection, and OpenCL argument binding. All 7,200 reference frames, including synthesized frames, matched v0.1.9 byte for byte at 120 and 240 FPS.

Extract the ZIP and open Open SVPflow.app on an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 26 or later. See the README for setup and compatibility details.
